2.341.4
Data Types
Every expression that is used in an expression element or as an argument to an RDL function MUST
return one of the following RDL data types: String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1), Boolean
([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.2), Float ([XMLSCHEMA2] section 3.2.4), DateTime ([XMLSCHEMA2]
section 3.2.7), Binary, or an array of these types (a VariantArray).<189>
